# DiskGarden

> DiskGarden is a free disk space analyzer for Mac. It maps every file and folder on your disk as an interactive chart, shows hidden space, and lets you clear space safely. No account; scans stay on the Mac.

- Requires macOS 15 or later. Free, no ads.

## Pages
- [Home](https://diskgarden.app/): what DiskGarden does
- [Download](https://diskgarden.app/download/): download, requirements, install steps
- [User guide](https://diskgarden.app/user-guide/)
- [Support and FAQ](https://diskgarden.app/support/)
- [Privacy](https://diskgarden.app/privacy/)

## Mac storage guides
- [Free up space on your Mac](https://diskgarden.app/guides/free-up-space-on-mac/): Find what's using your disk, where big files hide, and how to clear them safely.
- [What is System Data?](https://diskgarden.app/guides/system-data-mac/): What macOS counts as System Data, why it grows so large, and how to shrink it.
- [Why macOS takes so much space](https://diskgarden.app/guides/macos-system-storage/): The system volume, Recovery, swap, downloaded assets and updates — and what you can reclaim.
- [Find large files](https://diskgarden.app/guides/find-large-files-mac/): Storage settings, a Finder size search, and a map of every folder at once.
- [Clean up Xcode](https://diskgarden.app/guides/xcode-storage/): DerivedData, simulator runtimes, device support and archives — and how to clean them.
- [Docker taking up space](https://diskgarden.app/guides/docker-storage-mac/): Why Docker.raw grows, how to see its real size, and how to reclaim the space.
- [Old iPhone backups](https://diskgarden.app/guides/iphone-backups-mac/): Find and delete old device backups — and what to keep before you do.
- [Time Machine local snapshots](https://diskgarden.app/guides/time-machine-local-snapshots/): What local snapshots are, how to list them, and when to delete them.
- [Purgeable space](https://diskgarden.app/guides/purgeable-space-mac/): Why the disk can look full even when macOS calls space purgeable.
- [Spotlight's index](https://diskgarden.app/guides/spotlight-index-mac/): How big the Spotlight index is, why it balloons, and how to rebuild it.
- [Apple Intelligence storage](https://diskgarden.app/guides/apple-intelligence-storage/): How much space the on-device models need, and how to get it back.
- [Do you need a Mac cleaner?](https://diskgarden.app/guides/mac-cleaner-apps/): What cleaners really remove, why the space comes back, and what works better.
- [Clear caches safely](https://diskgarden.app/guides/clear-cache-mac/): Which caches are safe to delete, which to leave alone, and how much they free.
